text: {"reason": "34 supplier-switches at 45000 dominate cost=2165000; both shown stockout rows (medium 2.8d/5.3d) had alt-supplier lead exceeding inventory. Change middle branch to propose-internal-rebalance (6000, transfers 2-4d) and widen the alert gate to medium+ under 6 days so tight-inventory cases get always-on-time help, cutting cost and stockouts.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days) (cond ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 6)) (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review)) ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (list 'propose-internal-rebalance)) (else (list 'monitor))))"}
